QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] To Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: Fortunately, the Alliance decided to support the operation to reclaim Heliseum. Hurry and talk to #bNeinheart#k in #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.1: Everything worked out, and aid is on the way to the Heliseum Reclamation HQ. Hurry to #bPantheon#k to tell #bBeldar#k and help out at the Reclamation HQ.
QuestInfo.2: You told Beldar about the aid from the Alliance.

0.msg: ...This is how we are recruiting volunteers to support Operation Free Heliseum.

2.msg: It was a pleasure. We believe this is the right path for everyone. What will you do now?

3.msg: #bI will return to Pantheon to help my people.

4.msg: I see. I wish you luck.

1.0: Oh, Kaiser. How was it? Did it go well with the Cygnus Knights?

yes.0: Thank the stars. Everyone will join forces to defeat Magnus and reclaim Heliseum.

npc.0: Aid for the operation to reclaim Heliseum has been agreed upon. Please tell #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k about it.
